headline: Three people have shown this week and not one outcome is recorded. Two days with zero new replies while follow ups fell to 296.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Close the loop on three shows before anything else: luca showed yesterday, Robert showed Wednesday, both still say Talking with no result, and Evan has no Showed mark at all, so log whether he turned up. A show with no outcome is a deal quietly dying. Then feed the ladder: follow ups dropped to 296 from 429 and no new reply has landed since Monday, that gap is the cause.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Replies: zero in two days against a 15 person untagged queue. That is the input the whole month runs on. Cash holds at EUR 5,000 of 30,000 with 10 days left, and the three undecided shows are where the rest of August comes from.
